meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行 ESM 模型进行蛋白质结构预测与推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要预测蛋白质结构或运行 ESM 模型推理。
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and run ESM model inference
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict protein structures or run ESM model inference.

howto.what: 装好后,遇到 esm 相关任务时,Claude 会依据技能文档给出 Python 代码和步骤:生成/补全蛋白质序列、预测结构、由结构设计序列、提取 ESM C 嵌入,并说明模型选择、安装与 API 认证。
howto.when: 当你直接使用 esm Python SDK,或提到 ESM3/ESMC 模型名、Forge/Biohub 推理客户端、ESMFold2 折叠流程时触发。

say.text: 用 ESM3 补全这条序列,掩码处用 _ 表示:MPRT___KEND
say.note: Claude 会给出 ESM3 生成代码和补全后的序列。

say.text: 给我一个从 PDB 结构反推序列的 ESM 逆折叠示例
用 esmc_300m 计算这两条蛋白质序列的嵌入并比较
say.note: Claude 会给出 ESMC 嵌入代码与相似度分析。

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude can help with esm Python SDK tasks: generate/complete protein sequences, predict structure, inverse-fold sequences from structure, get ESM C embeddings, and explain model choice, install, and API auth.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work directly with the esm Python SDK, or mention ESM3/ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Use ESM3 to complete this sequence (masked as _): MPRT___KEND
say_en.note: Claude will show ESM3 code and the completed sequence.

say_en.text: Show an ESM inverse folding example from a PDB structure to a sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will use ESM3's structure track to design it.

say_en.text: Get esmc_300m embeddings for these two sequences and compare.
say_en.note: Claude will provide ESMC embedding code and similarity.
